arabic text: DADHKANO KA SILSILA KARBALA KARBALA\nDE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –\nKARBALA KARBALA
english translation text: Karbala is written upon the heart; the chain\nof heartbeats says: Karbala, Karbala. At every step,\nthese mourners raise one cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
FATIMA KA CHAYN HAI ALI KA NOOR E AYN HAI
SHAAH E MASHRAQAIN HAI WOH SHAHE MAGHRABAYN
HAI
HAI WOHI TO KARBALA JAHAAN MERA HUSSAIN HAI
JANNATO’N KA RAASTA
QISMATON KA FAISLA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
She is Fatima's comfort and Ali's
light of the eyes; he is
the King of East and West.
That Karbala alone is where
my Hussain rests. It is the
road to Paradise and the
decision of destiny. At every step,
the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
DEEN PER SHAHADATEIN SUNO NA BHOOL NA KABHI
KARLBAIYON NE HI SIKHAI SAB KO BANDAGI
KEH RAHA HAI YEH KHUDA MERE QAREEB HAI WOHI
JISNE BHI YEH KEHDIYA
YAANI MARZI E KHUDA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
Listen to the sacrifices for the
faith and never forget them. The
people of Karbala taught everyone worship.
God declares: nearest to Me is
the one who says only this:
the pleasure of God. At every
step, the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
NAAZ JIS PE AASMAA’N KARE YEH WOH ZAMEEN HAI
AKBAR E JAWAAN SA HASEE’N YAHAA’N MAKEEN HAI
IS LIYE YE SAR ZAMEEN AUR BHI HASEEN HAI
HUSN KI HAI INTEHA
MARHABA MARHABA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
This is the land of which
even the heavens are proud. The
beautiful young Akbar resides here; for
this reason the land itself is
even more beautiful. It is the
height of beauty— marhaba, marhaba. At
every step, the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text: IK TARAF SAJA HUWA HAI ROZA E SHAHE UMAM
english translation text: On one side stands the shrine of the King of the nations.

arabic text:
DOOSRI TARAF SAJA WAFA KE SHAAH KA HARAM
DO HARAM KE DARMIYA ATA SAKHA WAFA KARAM
EK BAAR JO GAYA
DEKHTA HI REH GAYA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
On the other stands the sanctuary
of the King of Loyalty. Between
the two sanctuaries are generosity, courage,
loyalty and grace. Whoever went there
once could only keep gazing. At
every step, the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
EK BAAR JO GAYA KARBALA KARBALA
BAS WHO TERA HOGAYA KARBALA KARBALA
HUR TERA NASEEB HAI KARBALA KARBALA
QISMATE HABIB HAI KARBALA KARBALA
JAUN KA GHUROOR HAI KARBALA KARBALA
KIBRIYA KA NOOR HAI KARBALA KARBALA
DIL ZUHAYR QAYN KA KARBALA KARBALA
MADRASA HUSSAIN KA KARBALA KARBALA
HAA’N WAHAB KI SHAAN HAI KARBALA KARBALA
JEET KA NISHAAN HAI KARBALA KARBALA
DHAAL HAI HAI SAEED KI KARBALA KARBALA
MAUT HAI YAZEED KI KARBALA KARBALA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
Whoever went once became yours—Karbala,
Karbala. Hurr is your destiny—Karbala,
Karbala. It is Habib's fortune—Karbala,
Karbala. It is Jaun's pride—Karbala,
Karbala. It is the light
of the Almighty—Karbala, Karbala. It
is the heart of Zuhayr
ibn Qayn—Karbala, Karbala. It is
Hussain's school—Karbala, Karbala. It is Wahab's
honour—Karbala, Karbala. It is the
sign of victory—Karbala, Karbala. It is
Saeed's shield—Karbala, Karbala. It is
Yazid's death—Karbala, Karbala. At every step,
the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
SAJDA E HUSSAIN SE HI ISHQ SARFARAZ HAI
KARBALA NE HI HUMEIN SIKHAYA KYA NAMAAZ HAI
DEEN KYA HAI KYA WILAYAT E ALI KA RAAZ HAI
HAI HUMARI DARSGAH
HAQ KA SEEDHA RAASTA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
Through Hussain's prostration, love itself was
honoured. Karbala taught us what prayer
truly means, what the faith is,
and the secret of Ali's wilayah.
It is our school and the
straight path of truth. At every
step, the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text: YEH HAI WOH ZAMEEN JAHAAN LUTA HAI FATIMA KA\nGHAR\nMAA KE SAAMNE JAHAAN PE QATL HOGAYE PISAR
english translation text: This is the land where\nFatima's home was plundered and sons\nwere killed before their mothers.

arabic text:
FATIMA KE LAAL KA BHI KAT GAYA YAHEEN PE SAR
DIL NE RO KE YEH KAHAA
WAA HUSSAIN GHURBATA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
Here Fatima's son's head
was severed. The heart
wept and cried: alas, Hussain's
loneliness. At every step,
the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
AKBAR E JAWAAN KE JIGAR ME TOR DI SINA
TEER KHAKE HALQ PER TARAP RAHA THA BE ZUBAA
TUKRE TUKRE HOGAYA YEHEE’N PE QAASIM E JAWAAN
HAI YEHI’N WHO BAWAFA
JO HARAM KI AAS THA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
The spear was broken within young Akbar's
heart. The speechless infant writhed after receiving
the arrow upon his throat. Young Qasim
was torn into pieces here. Here
too lies the faithful one who was
the hope of the sanctuary. At
every step, the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.

arabic text:
HAI HUSAINIYO PE KHAAS YEH ATA E SAYYADA
HAR GHARI RAWAA’N HAI LAB PE ZIKR E SHAAH E
KARBALA
IS SE BARH KE AUR KYA SILA MILEGA ISHQ KA
ZEESHAN NE KAHAA
AUR KARIM NE PARHA
DE RAHE HAI YEH QADAM QADAM PE MATAMI SADA –
KARBALA KARBALA
english translation text:
This is the Sayyida's special gift
to Hussain's followers: at every moment,
remembrance of the King of Karbala
flows upon their lips. What reward
for love could be greater than
this? Zeeshan said it, and
Karim recited it. At every step,
the mourners cry: Karbala, Karbala.
